patterns.name: All Downstrokes
patterns.description: Simple quarter note downstrokes. The most basic pattern.

patterns.name: Straight Eighths
patterns.description: Alternating down and up strokes on every eighth note.

patterns.name: Island Strum
patterns.description: The classic island/campfire strum. D DU UD — works with almost any song.

patterns.name: Old Faithful
patterns.description: D DU UDU — the most common rock/pop strumming pattern.

patterns.name: Folk Strum
patterns.description: D D DU — simple pattern great for folk and country songs.

patterns.name: Pop Rock
patterns.description: D DU UDU — energetic pattern used in pop and rock music.

patterns.name: Boom-Chicka
patterns.description: D DUD DU — classic country/bluegrass boom-chicka pattern.

patterns.name: Reggae Skank
patterns.description: Upstrokes on the offbeats — the signature reggae feel.

patterns.name: Ballad Strum
patterns.description: D D DU DU — gentle pattern perfect for slow ballads.

patterns.name: Driving Rock
patterns.description: D DU D DU — driving rhythm great for upbeat rock songs.

patterns.name: Syncopated Pop
patterns.description: D UDU DU — syncopated pattern with a groovy feel.

patterns.name: Acoustic Flow
patterns.description: D D U DU — flowing pattern for acoustic singer-songwriter style.
